cl_meta.interface:
GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource -> 200 application/json (document above)
Any /mcp request without a valid token -> 401, header: WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="<https URL of the document>"
cl_meta.code:
from starlette.responses import JSONResponse
from starlette.routing import Route

RESOURCE = os.environ['MCP_RESOURCE_URL']      # exactly what clients type
ISSUER = os.environ['OIDC_ISSUER_URL']
META_URL = RESOURCE.rsplit('/', 1)[0] + '/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource'

async def protected_resource(request):
    return JSONResponse(
        {'resource': RESOURCE,
         'authorization_servers': [ISSUER],
         'scopes_supported': ['brain.read'],
         'bearer_methods_supported': ['header']},
        headers={'Cache-Control': 'max-age=300'})

def challenge():
    # one generic 401 body: never say why the token failed
    return JSONResponse(
        {'error': 'unauthorized'}, status_code=401,
        headers={'WWW-Authenticate': f'Bearer resource_metadata="{META_URL}"'})

async def selfcheck(client):
    doc = (await client.get(META_URL)).json()
    assert doc['resource'] == RESOURCE, 'resource mismatch'
    meta = (await client.get(ISSUER.rstrip('/') + '/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server')).json()
    assert meta['issuer'].rstrip('/') == ISSUER.rstrip('/'), 'issuer mismatch'
    assert meta.get('code_challenge_methods_supported') == ['S256'], 'S256 only'

routes = [Route('/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource', protected_resource)]

cl_consent.code:
import hmac, hashlib, secrets, time

KEY = os.environ['CONSENT_STATE_KEY'].encode()
TTL = 600

def make_state(user_id, source_id):
    nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(16)
    exp = int(time.time()) + TTL
    body = f'{user_id}|{source_id}|{nonce}|{exp}'
    sig = hmac.new(KEY, body.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return f'{body}|{sig}'

async def require_link(db, vault, user_id, tenant_id, source_id):
    if await vault.has_link(user_id, source_id):
        return None
    row = await db.fetchrow(
        'select state from pending_link where user_id=$1 and source_id=$2 and not used and expires_at>now()',
        user_id, source_id)
    state = row['state'] if row else make_state(user_id, source_id)
    if not row:
        await db.execute(
            "insert into pending_link values ($1,$2,$3,$4, now()+interval '10 minutes', false)",
            state, user_id, tenant_id, source_id)
    url = f'https://{HOST}/connect?state={state}'
    return ElicitUrl(mode='url', url=url, message=f'Link {source_id} to continue')

async def complete(db, session_user, state):
    uid = state.split('|')[0]
    if uid != session_user:                # the tricky part: bind to the signed-in user
        raise Forbidden()
    n = await db.execute('update pending_link set used=true where state=$1 and not used and expires_at>now()', state)
    if n != 'UPDATE 1':
        raise Expired()
